decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.
Condition : 3 - The external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match the rendered whitewashed side and rear elevations of the main house.

Condition : 4 - The window and door formed in the southern flank of the extension shall be obscure glazed, should be hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 60 Clevedon Gardens Hounslow.

Condition : 8 - The proposed single-storey rear extension, because of its position, design and appearance, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property and the area and would not harm neighbours' living conditions.  The development complies with Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Demolition of existing rear extension and construction of new single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
